content: [![「LopyMine 的專案」Discord 伺服器連結](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/21f178aff2b64844fefeaf94a3a3a418440fd43f.png)](https://discord.gg/NZzxdkrV4s) [![GitHub 連結橫幅](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d87060a9e4522786e45b4b54d10853a1b4a91b10.png)](https://github.com/LopyMine/Inventory-Interactions) [![支援連結橫幅 [Boosty]](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dce91fef079649dee277c52a998fc068e745e99e.png)](https://boosty.to/lopymine/donate) [![CurseForge 連結橫幅](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c39affcb732c8b1a4fe189e79898c686da3d63e2.png)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/inventory-interactions) [![Modrinth 連結橫幅](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9991553f6a20e5105b9b153b8d817bc3630c18a8.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/inventory-interactions) ![「說明」標題](https://github.com/LopyMine/Profile/blob/main/files/Template%20Resource%20Pack/image2.webp?raw=true) **庫存互動** — 為 [**庫存粒子**](https://modrinth.com/mod/inventory-particles) 設計的擴充套件。此擴充套件新增了多種物品互動功能！例如，當您在背包中手持物品時，此擴充套件會為物品加入物理效果： ![遊戲內展示](https://github.com/LopyMine/Profile/blob/main/files/inventory-interactions/ingameshowcase.webp?raw=true)
